title: Preserve conservative mutation reporting when the begin source basis is missing
outcome: A missing begin comparison cannot suppress a mutation obligation solely because a debounced watcher missed an edit; unconfirmed source remains uncredited.
acceptance: The mutation-grant missing-begin/successful-close path reports conservatively without assigning an unconfirmed credited source basis, or adopts an independently concurred explicit policy with equivalent evidence safety.
A regression covers missing begin basis and no watcher event under mutation and observation-only grants, keeping credited source attribution withheld.
